# fetch libraries (already small, but do again for self-containment)

def fetch_all_song_library():
    page_index=0
    all_items=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        all_items.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    return all_items

def fetch_all_album_library():
    page_index=0
    all_items=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20,sort_by=None,query='')
        if not res:
            break
        all_items.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    return all_items

def fetch_all_playlists(is_public):
    page_index=0
    all_items=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20,sort_by=None,query='',is_public=is_public)
        if not res:
            break
        all_items.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    return all_items

songs=fetch_all_song_library()
albums=fetch_all_album_library()

    for sid in a.get('song_ids',[]):

        song_ids.add(sid)

song_ids_sorted=sorted(song_ids)

min_date=None
candidates=[]

for i,sid in enumerate(song_ids_sorted):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd=sd.get('release_date')
    title=sd.get('title')
    # release_date expected ISO
    if rd is None:
        continue
    if min_date is None or rd < min_date:
        min_date=rd
        candidates=[{'song_id':sid,'title':title,'release_date':rd}]
    elif rd == min_date:
        candidates.append({'song_id':sid,'title':title,'release_date':rd})
    if (i+1)%20==0:
        print('processed',i+1,'current_min',min_date,'candidate_count',len(candidates))

print('min_release_date',min_date)
print('candidate_titles',[c['title'] for c in candidates])
print('candidate_details',candidates)
